fullPassage: Hunger Stones In the summer of 2022, during the worst drought in 500 years in Europe, a stone known as a “hunger stone” was found in a Czech town along the Elbe River. The stone had a sentence written on it that read: “If you see me, then cry.” The hunger stones, found in rivers across central Europe, typically remain underwater. However, when droughts occur and water levels retreat, these stones become visible. The stones are significant because they bear records of the past severe droughts. Droughts cause reduced harvests, food shortages, and hunger, especially for the poor. The words on the hunger stones are believed to warn of these hardships and to urge people to be prepared. Considering the continuation of climate change, experts warn that the situation we face is not just a simple, occasional drought but a severe drought that could persist for decades. The United Nations has predicted that by 2050, 75 percent of the global population could suffer from the effects of drought unless significant action is taken to address climate change.

정관사 the와 전치사 of 사이의 빈칸에는 명사가 와야 함. 동사 continue를 명사 continuation으로 변형.
continue(동사) → continuation(명사)
det.tip: 동사 continue에 -ation을 붙여 명사 continuation(지속)을 만듭니다.

questions.passage: Hunger Stones In the summer of 2022, during the worst drought in 500 years in Europe, a stone known as a “hunger stone” was found in a Czech town along the Elbe River.  The stone had a sentence written on it that read: “If you see me, then cry. ” The hunger stones, found in rivers across central Europe, typically remain underwater.  However, when droughts occur and water levels retreat, these stones become visible.  The stones are significant because they bear records of the past severe droughts.  Droughts cause reduced harvests, food shortages, and hunger, especially for the poor.  The words on the hunger stones are believed to warn of these hardships and to urge people to be prepared.  Considering the continuation of climate change, experts warn that the situation we face is not just a simple, occasional drought but a severe drought that could persist for decades.  The United Nations has predicted that by 2050, 75 percent of the global population could suffer from the effects of drought unless significant action is taken to address climate change.

'문장이 적혀 있었다'는 명사 a sentence를 과거분사 written이 뒤에서 수식하는 구조(a sentence written on it).
The(1) stone(2) had(3) a(4) sentence(5) written(6) on(7) it(8) = 8단어
det.tip: 명사 뒤에서 '~된'을 나타낼 때 과거분사(written)를 씁니다(a sentence written on it).
